rule: A field fails when its strict accuracy drops by more than max_drop against the baseline on the same set AND at least min_fields fewer fields are right. Fixed 2026-11-15 before the per-field numbers were inspected.

pairs.why: docs/20 'no regression': adding CORD must not hurt the existing synthetic dev sets (the two sets named in the criterion)

trade:dev|invoice_number_raw.reason: known regression found by this gate on 2026-11-15 (after the rule was fixed): adding CORD lost 3 of 24 invoice numbers on own dev (0.958 -> 0.833); the overall criterion (-0.003) hid it; reported in README section 6

pairs.why: docs/20 amendment 3: the up-weighting attempt must not cost other fields

cord:dev|sub.count.reason: amendment 3 (no effect) also lost sub-item counts: 8 -> 3 of 32; reported in README section 6

cord:dev|sub.name.reason: amendment 3: sub-item names 14 -> 10 of 49; reported in README section 6

pairs.why: docs/20 amendment 2: seed repeats should not differ field by field beyond the gate

cord:dev|sub.count.reason: seed variance: sub-item fields are few (32 counts, 49 names) and swing by 4-5 fields between seeds; reported with the seed table

accepted_note: 'accepted' entries were added after the first gate run (2026-11-15) for results that were already final; each names the drop and where it is reported, and is pinned to the exact base/new counts it was granted for (2026-11-15, astra review 5): a further fall, or a field or set missing from a report, fails CI. Any other field over the limit fails CI.
